responsibility: Declares the spelling-correction helper used by front-end diagnostics. It exposes the callback type, the shared identifier-character set, and the `speller` entry point that higher-level lookup code calls when suggesting likely intended names.
same_name_distinction: Declares the spelling callback type, the exported idchars table, and the speller entry point; unlike speller.c, it does not implement the edit-distance-style search or define the candidate-generation logic.
